root_cause.text: The ALSA fireworks driver lacks bounds checking on a device-supplied 32-bit status value before using it as an index to access the `efr_status_names` array in `efw_transaction()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the direct array lookup `efr_status_names[be32_to_cpu(header->status)]` was replaced with a ternary operator that bounds-checks the status value `st` against `ARRAY_SIZE(efr_status_names)` before accessing the array: `st < ARRAY_SIZE(efr_status_names) ? efr_status_names[st] : "unknown"`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add bounds checking to status array lookups to prevent out-of-bounds memory access.
intent_record.what: Introduced a local variable to store the decoded status and added a boundary check against the size of the efr_status_names array before accessing it.
intent_record.how: Prevents potential out-of-bounds array access and kernel crashes when handling unexpected status codes from the hardware.
